shortDescription: Manage bash aliases and functions for many users (idempotent, fast)

options.name: backup
options.description: Create backups of files before changing or deleting them.

options.name: fail_on_error
options.description: If true, the task fails at the end when any user entry failed, but still returns full results. If false, returns success and reports failures in results/summary.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether managed files and bashrc block should exist. C(absent) removes managed files and the marker block from C(.bashrc).

options.name: users
options.description: List of user specifications. Unknown users do not stop processing; they are reported as failed in the result.
